packageRules.description: Bun is pinned in mise.toml (local and CI) and in services/qyl.mcp/package.json packageManager (Railway); move both, and the bun constraint above, in one PR so every bun.lock stays readable by the Bun that installs it.

Microsoft.OpenApi is pinned to 2.x (see Directory.Packages.props): 3.x makes IOpenApiMediaType.Example read-only, which the Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi XML-comment source generator still assigns — CS0200 in generated code we must not hand-edit. Re-enable majors once ASP.NET's generator supports OpenAPI.NET v3.

The collector image's runtime-deps base follows the TargetFramework every qyl project builds for (net10.0): runtime-deps:11.0 carries the .NET 11 native dependencies and not the .NET 10 ones, so the .NET 10 collector published onto it does not start. The major moves only in the PR that moves the TargetFramework. Minor and digest updates stay on.
Freeze the MSBuild API to the .NET 10-compatible 18.9.6 build host.
